return_binding.quantity_mapping: Partial quantities may map by original ordinal only where their per-line obligations are equal; mixed-price partial units or a later request reusing linked original units are ambiguous and fail closed
return_binding.receipt_authority: Read the existing warehouse source return-event journal; do not copy administrative received flags into a new money or stock ledger
return_binding.uncertain_receipts: Every current canonical request must be linked. Missing events, partial latest completeness or missing expected units prevent final capture
return_binding.corrections: Use the effective latest observation of each original unit; a linked correction can change retained quantity and compensation visibility

extensions.bound: Cumulative extension_ms cannot exceed the independently approved terms maximum_extension_ms
extensions.activation: Only a successfully observed canonical reauthorization changes trial_extension_ms; consent or quote alone leaves the existing clock unchanged
extensions.expiry: The recalculated delivery end plus return grace must precede the exact new source mandate expiry

final_capture.amount: min(exact retained original unit obligations, current explicit consent maximum, exact approved command amount)
final_capture.zero_obligation: No positive capture is issued; an independently approved canonical cancellation can waive the remaining obligation
current_checks: no other authorized or unknown original operation
final_capture.final_source_boundary: Repeat the canonical approval/readiness/receipt checks inside the original source transaction immediately before the new effect. Current delivery and receipt digests are in the approved command, so an observation change invalidates the old quote and produces an original rejected outcome without capture

operation_identity.key: Existing deterministic InstantExchanges operation identity for scoped obligation, kind and generation
operation_identity.concurrent_dispatch: The existing local state transition admits one dispatch; the original source binding and unique capture fence prevent duplicate effects
operation_identity.known_rejection: A new capture generation is available only after every earlier native capture operation is rejected and local uncertainty is resolved
operation_identity.lost_response: Retain the original operation as unknown and reconcile its original source identity; neither a different quote, request nor operation ID authorizes another capture
operation_identity.readiness_revoked_lookup: An actor with current operation.reconcile permission may look up a proven stored original context after readiness outage/revocation; no new send is granted
operation_identity.late_return: Original source obligation read exposes compensation_required_minor; no automatic refund, recapture or warehouse movement follows

privacy_restore.exports: Scoped trial rows and linked terms/approvals; no consent session hash or replay credential
privacy_restore.erasure: Explicit allowlists and pseudonymization on every invocation, including hash-only replay; preserve minimal original operation/source/amount/state identity
privacy_restore.unknown_state: Erasure, restore and uninstall never claim an unknown native payment was rejected, canceled, reversed or absent
privacy_restore.restore: Revoke all trial term approvals and consent authority, strip session material, and mark active trials restore_blocked
privacy_restore.external_cleanup: Separate original source stores, immutable native receipts, historic exports and caller copies require their own authorized retention or cleanup; no external erasure confirmation is inferred

remaining_limits: No connected payment, real capture or settlement qualification
Separate warehouse/payment stores are synthetic fixture authorities; no distributed processor/warehouse transaction or physical race qualification is claimed
No automatic timer, extension, refund, compensation, stock movement or retry of an unknown operation
Original M10-G13 and M07-G99 acceptance remain prerequisites for formal qualification
No migration rollback drops original payment identities or unresolved obligations
